name: generate-design-skill
description: Quality-steering skill pack for an HTML-only design generator: single index.html output, one page per run, freeform natural-language tweaks, DESIGN.md as cross-run consistency memory. Skills only inject for CSS/JS/HTML/UI intent (gated on prompt signals like html, css, page, landing, index.html); suppressed for non-web workflows such as Roblox Lua.
source: Distilled from Open CoDesign (https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign), MIT License — prompt sections packages/core/src/prompts/sections/*.md and skills apps/desktop/resources/templates/skills/{craft-polish,frontend-design-anti-slop,responsive-layout}.md

activation.when: prompt indicates CSS/JS/HTML/UI work (keywords: html, css, index.html, DESIGN.md, page, landing, portfolio, website, hero, tailwind, frontend, etc.) or workspace tweak of existing index.html; suppressed for non-web tasks (e.g. Roblox Lua). Override with /design-new or /design-tweak.
activation.blockedWhen: prompt matches Roblox/Lua/game-script signals without web file refs

systemPromptWhenRelevant.when: inject only when isDesignRelevant(prompt, cwd) is true (html/css/page/landing/index.html) or /design-new forced; suppressed for non-web workflows
always include if workspace uses DESIGN.md and gate passed; otherwise include on first gated run so the file gets created
inject before the final self-check phase of each gated run
inject only on gated follow-up edit/tweak turns, replacing design-workflow.md step 4-5 emphasis
